question.text: Equal volumes of molar hydrochloric acid and sulphuric acid are neutralised by dilute $\mathrm{NaOH}$ solution and $\mathrm{x} \mathrm{kcal}$ and $\mathrm{y} \mathrm{kcal}$ of heat are liberated respectively. Which of the following is true?

solution.text: Enthalpy of $1 \mathrm{~g}$ equivalent of strong acid and $1 \mathrm{~g}$ equivalent strong base $=13.7 \mathrm{kcal}$ Equal volume contains double eq. of $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{SO}_4$ than $\mathrm{HCl}$
